name: Printed rocker · OFF
description: Three printed mounting and rocker parts, with the toggle off and fingers clear at rest.

name: Printed rocker · Press ON
description: Rounded rocker finger reaches the ON contact position.

name: Printed rocker · Wide base · ON
description: 120 × 100 mm printed base with the toggle on and the rocker centred.

name: Guided fork · Panel mounting · OFF
description: 160 × 96 mm mounting base with the fork centred and the toggle off.

name: Guided fork · Wide enclosure mounting · ON
description: 180 × 120 mm base with the toggle on and the fork returned to centre.

name: Guided fork · Raised switch platform · OFF
description: Switch case mounting face at 65 mm, with the same source switch mounting stack and contact height.

name: Guided fork · Press ON
description: Inspect the ON push, with the servo turned and the soft contact pad compressed.

name: Parallel-shaft rocker · OFF
description: 80 × 110 mm panel-mounted assembly with four PETG parts, including a separate lower servo and switch cradle, and two external thin TPU frames beneath a flat flange without gasket recesses. The opposed bar rests across the servo, leaving the toggle free for manual operation.

name: Parallel-shaft rocker · Press ON
description: 80 × 110 mm panel-mounted assembly with four PETG parts, including a separate lower servo and switch cradle, and two external thin TPU frames beneath a flat flange without gasket recesses. Inspect one end of the opposed bar at its calculated ON contact.

name: Parallel-shaft rocker · Larger flange · OFF
description: 100 × 120 mm panel-mounted assembly with four PETG parts, including a separate lower servo and switch cradle, and two external thin TPU frames beneath a flat flange without gasket recesses. The larger flange provides more space for the enclosure mounting.

name: Two switches · ARM 1 OFF · cover closed
description: 150 × 100 mm flange along X/Y, with ARM 1 manual on the left and ARM 2 servo-operated on the right. OFF leans toward the labels; the cover opens away. Four PETG parts with a flat flange underside and three external thin TPU frames; ARM 2 is OFF at rest.

name: Two switches · ARM 1 OFF · cover open
description: 150 × 100 mm flange along X/Y, with ARM 1 manual on the left and ARM 2 servo-operated on the right. OFF leans toward the labels; the cover opens away. Four PETG parts with a flat flange underside and three external thin TPU frames; ARM 2 is OFF at rest.

name: Two switches · ARM 1 ON · cover open
description: 160 × 110 mm flange along X/Y, with ARM 1 manual on the left and ARM 2 servo-operated on the right. OFF leans toward the labels; the cover opens away. Four PETG parts with a flat flange underside and three external thin TPU frames; ARM 2 is OFF at rest.
